data.name: Parmjeet
data.gender_notes: Parmjeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parm means supreme, and jeet means victory. Therefore, Parmjeet means 'Supreme Victory' or 'God of Victory'. The name Parmjeet carries the meaning “Supreme God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parmjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and devotion to the divine.
data.etymology: Parmjeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parmjeet total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
